title: The first site
body: Marc begins as a small contracting outfit in Ahilyanagar, constructing bungalows, industrial sheds and similar work. Six people, one site, one supervisor who is still with the firm.

title: The first residential project
body: Bajraj, the first residential project constructed by Marc, and the start of the housing work the firm is known for.

title: RERA and the register
body: The first project registered by any developer in Ahilyanagar district. Every project from here is registered with MahaRERA — registration numbers go on the hoarding, the brochure and, later, the website.

title: Multiple sites, one city
body: Multiple projects under construction across Savedi, Nalegaon and Bhistabag; 100+ delivered addresses; 1,000+ families in Marc buildings.
